conditional_predictions.rationale: If trial content drives performance, randomizing labels at the trial level should break any task mapping for each new label configuration, reducing BA to chance.

If session identity effects drive performance, permuting labels within trials while preserving class counts might still allow metadata-based prediction if sessions are preserved; however, the tool randomizes at trial level so this is less clear. We expect near-zero gap as a baseline.

prediction.update_rule_if_opposite: If BA remains high after shuffling (positive direction), H3 gains support over H1 regarding identity effects persisting despite label permutation.
